title: Each session keeps to its tier, and a hook points the owner to the right one
why: shiv, Oct 31 15:31 to 15:32 CDT, owner chat (via coordinator session_013NEJL2pASwRjgJDnsvnpNe): the coordinator took owner questions that belong to triage; sessions must point him to the right tier, and "it needs to be like an actual fix": a hook or check, not prose. Second incident the same hour: the classifier refused the coordinator's message handing banchi #1002's merge to the batch runner ('Merge Without Review'), so merges stay with the coordinator.
note: Lane started Oct 31 15:32 CDT (coordinator). Fix: a hook or check that knows each session's tier (its cs-build tag, per get_session) and refuses or redirects work that belongs to another tier: owner questions to triage, merges to the batch runner, building to lanes; style rule style-wrong-tier-one-line becomes enforced, not prose. It also covers the batch-runner merge handoff the classifier refused. The lane sends triage any ruling it needs for the page. Done check: test cases show a coordinator writing an owner question and a non-runner merging both refused or redirected, red on main and green on the fix. Ruling (shiv, Nov 1 04:26 CST, page item 113 pick a): each lane posts a fixed review record on its PR (PR, head, each round with reviewer and verdict, CI state); the batch runner finds reviewed, green PRs itself at each wake, and no merge request message is sent. Until built, the handoff message uses the same form. Item 113 a sent to the lane, session_013NEJKzVTWMbokJ3KFanBBC (coordinator, 04:30 CST). Ruling (shiv, Nov 1 11:53 CST, page item 111 pick a): in a coordinator build, the batch runner runs every merge and the coordinator runs no build or review agents; standing-merge-grant is rewritten to match; solo and one-lane sessions keep merging their own work. Item 112 (how hard the check stops) still waits on shiv.
